prompt: Purchase order receiving creates a laptop asset whose serial number already exists on a CMDB CI. With IRE-based CI creation enabled for that model category, what is the expected result?
choices: Asset creation fails because the serial number is already present on an existing CI or asset
The platform silently merges both records into a consumable quantity without review
A second asset is created and both records keep the same serial number indefinitely
Discovery deletes the existing CI so the new asset can reuse the serial without conflict
explanation: When IRE-based CI creation is in use for eligible model categories, serial numbers must be unique; asset creation fails if the serial already exists on a CI or asset.
domain: Data Integrity Attributes and Data Sources

prompt: CMDB integration requires governed CI creation when assets are received with serial numbers. Which system property enables IRE-based CI creation from assets?
choices: glide.asset.create_ci_with_ire
glide.create_alm_asset.async
csdm.lifecycle.sync.between.ci.and.asset.activated
sn_itam_enable_cache_for_asset_ci_mapping
explanation: glide.asset.create_ci_with_ire enables CI creation from assets through the CMDB Identification and Reconciliation engine for eligible CI classes that identify on serial number and have no dependent relationships.
domain: Data Integrity Attributes and Data Sources

prompt: A CIO asks the implementation team to draft a three-year IT Asset Management program roadmap. Which scope best aligns with ServiceNow ITAM guidance?
choices: Manage hardware, software, and cloud spend across procurement, deployment, maintenance, and retirement with governed data and financial controls
Track CMDB classes only without inventory, procurement, or lifecycle financial context for hardware estates
Defend software publisher audits exclusively without hardware stockroom or fulfillment automation
Map network topology from cloud APIs without linking assets to ownership, cost, or disposal workflows
explanation: ITAM is the management of IT assets across their lifecycle, covering ownership, location, usage, cost, and value delivery.
domain: IT Asset Management Overview and Fundamentals

prompt: An enterprise wants unified visibility across on-premises laptops, SaaS subscriptions, and AWS EC2 instances. Which ServiceNow ITAM design supports that outcome?
choices: Deploy Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management modules without any asset applications
Rely on Discovery and Service Mapping alone without SAM, HAM, or cloud cost applications
Use Performance Analytics dashboards only without normalized asset or entitlement records
Integrate Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, and Cloud Cost Management under a shared ITAM governance model
explanation: The ITAM suite comprises SAM, HAM, and Cloud Cost Management applications for software, hardware, and cloud spend visibility.
domain: IT Asset Management Overview and Fundamentals

prompt: Why would an organization opt in to the Hardware Asset Management Content Service?
choices: Remove all hardware models from the product catalog automatically after opt-in
Replace stock rules with manual spreadsheet ordering for every stockroom location
Disable weekly manufacturer updates from the hardware content library permanently
Share anonymized unnormalized model data to improve recognition and receive content updates
explanation: Opting in allows ServiceNow to improve normalization rules using anonymized customer model data while delivering tailored content updates.
domain: Data Integrity Attributes and Data Sources

prompt: Which Discovery outcome most directly improves hardware asset record accuracy in HAM?
choices: Current hardware attributes and serial numbers reconciled with modeled asset classes
Automatic closure of open transfer orders at the time each discovery schedule completes
Conversion of every open incident into an asset task without stockroom validation
Removal of all CMDB relationships for network gear discovered on corporate subnets
explanation: Discovery supplies current hardware attributes that HAM can reconcile with models, serials, and asset classes for trustworthy records.

prompt: How do weekly HAM content updates improve data integrity?
choices: They replace stock rules with static reorder spreadsheets for every stockroom manager
They retire all assets exceeding five years of age automatically without approval
They supply manufacturer and device type normalization content for hardware models
They remove consumable inventory from stockroom audits and barcode scan workflows
explanation: Weekly content updates deliver manufacturer, device type, and lifecycle normalization data to keep hardware and consumable models accurate.

prompt: Infrastructure teams deploy Windows and Linux VMs in AWS and Azure alongside on-premises servers. How should HAM track those hybrid assets?
choices: Convert every VM into a consumable quantity without CI or asset linkage
Disable model normalization for cloud-discovered records to speed imports
Combine Discovery and cloud inventory feeds with normalized models and lifecycle states for virtual and physical hardware assets
Track only on-premises serial numbers and ignore cloud instances in the asset table
explanation: Modern HAM programs reconcile Discovery and cloud source data into governed hardware models with consistent lifecycle tracking.
domain: Operational Integration of IT Asset Management Processes

prompt: A SaaS team procures 5,000 collaboration seats while HAM manages corporate laptops. Which ITAM approach prevents duplicate spend and orphan assignments?
choices: Retire laptop assets automatically when any SaaS subscription is activated
Coordinate SAM subscription records with HAM hardware assets through shared requester, cost center, and lifecycle governance
Track SaaS seats only in spreadsheets outside ServiceNow to avoid SAM licensing
Disable HAM catalog fulfillment whenever SAM records exist for the same user
explanation: Integrated ITAM connects SAM subscription management with HAM hardware custody and financial ownership for complete spend visibility.
domain: Operational Integration of IT Asset Management Processes
